scope: Known generated-PDF cmap length and head subtraction-borrow defects; font-container-only repair, not full OpenType/PDF or document standards certification

rootCauses.cmap: fpdf v0.12.0 generateCMAPTable declares length from numSymbols, not emitted bytes; invalid odd or truncated/out-of-bounds known declarations need local repair. Legal shorter even declarations with zero range offsets are preserved.
rootCauses.head: calcInt32 increments instead of decrementing the high word on subtraction borrow, producing checksum B1B2AFBA; only the exact known borrow result or correct original adjustment is accepted.

independentValidator.method: Independent decoded FontFile2 SFNT/checksum/cmap validation plus actual fontTools parse/getBestCmap; not manuscript extraction or a visual conformance certificate.
independentValidator.boundary: Missing optional tables are not rejected. Redundant SFNT search hints are advisory; bounds, table/whole checksums, head adjustment, implemented cmap structures and actual fontTools parse remain fatal checks. No full OpenType or PDF visual-conformance claim.

unused bytes after declared subtable are not mistaken for an error
valid indirect idRangeOffset resolves inside the actual glyph array
format4 arrays outside declared length rejected
format4 range offset outside array rejected
format4 glyph index outside maxp rejected
valid non-BMP format12 groups fully checked
format12 glyph range outside maxp rejected
format12 group declaration length mismatch rejected
shared subtable offsets and intervening/outside bytes are accepted
missing optional OS2 name and post do not invalidate a usable subset
full 32-bit head adjustment corruption remains fatal
absent cmap is explicitly inapplicable rather than fake getBestCmap success
